title: John the Baptist's Death and Jesus Walks on Water

questions.question: Who thought Jesus was John the Baptist raised from the dead?
options: Herod the tetrarch
Pontius Pilate
Caesar Augustus
The High Priest Caiaphas
questions.explanation: Matthew 14:1-2 (ESV): "At that time Herod the tetrarch heard about the fame of Jesus, and he said to his servants, 'This is John the Baptist. He has been raised from the dead...'"

questions.question: Why had Herod originally arrested and imprisoned John the Baptist?
options: Because of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife, since John told him it was not lawful for him to have her
Because John was raising a rebel army
Because John refused to pay the temple tax
Because John prophesied Herod would die in battle
questions.correctAnswer: Because of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife, since John told him it was not lawful for him to have her
questions.explanation: Matthew 14:3-4 (ESV): "For Herod had seized John and bound him and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife, because John had been saying to him, 'It is not lawful for you to have her.'"

questions.question: What prompted Herod to promise with an oath to give the daughter of Herodias whatever she might ask?
options: She danced before the company and pleased Herod on his birthday
She interpreted his dream correctly
She had recently recovered from a severe illness
She played the harp for his guests
questions.correctAnswer: She danced before the company and pleased Herod on his birthday
questions.explanation: Matthew 14:6 (ESV): "But when Herod's birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced before the company and pleased Herod,"

questions.question: After being prompted by her mother, what specifically did the daughter ask for?
options: "Give me the head of John the Baptist here on a platter."
"Give me half your kingdom."
"Give me fifty talents of gold."
"Release my mother from her marriage vow."
questions.correctAnswer: "Give me the head of John the Baptist here on a platter."
questions.explanation: Matthew 14:8 (ESV): "Prompted by her mother, she said, 'Give me the head of John the Baptist here on a platter.'"

questions.question: When Jesus heard about the death of John, what did He do?
options: He withdrew from there in a boat to a desolate place by himself
He gathered a crowd to march against Herod
He wept openly in the streets of Nazareth
He gave a sermon condemning all earthly rulers
questions.correctAnswer: He withdrew from there in a boat to a desolate place by himself
questions.explanation: Matthew 14:13 (ESV): "Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a desolate place by himself."

questions.question: Even though He wanted solitude, when Jesus went ashore He saw a great crowd, had compassion on them, and did what?
options: He healed their sick
He commanded them to give to the poor
He sent them away angrily to their homes
He immediately fed them
questions.explanation: Matthew 14:14 (ESV): "When he went ashore he saw a great crowd, and he had compassion on them and healed their sick."

questions.question: As evening approached, how many loaves and fish did the disciples tell Jesus they had?
options: Five loaves here and two fish
Seven loaves and a few small fish
Two loaves and five fish
Three loaves and two fish
questions.correctAnswer: Five loaves here and two fish
questions.explanation: Matthew 14:17 (ESV): "They said to him, 'We have only five loaves here and two fish.'"

questions.question: Before Jesus broke the loaves to feed the crowd, what did He do while looking up to heaven?
options: He said a blessing
He sang a psalm of David
He spoke in tongues
He commanded an angel to appear
questions.explanation: Matthew 14:19 (ESV): "...taking the five loaves and the two fish, he looked up to heaven and said a blessing. Then he broke the loaves..."

questions.question: How many baskets full of broken pieces were left over after everyone ate and was satisfied?
options: Twelve
Seven
Three
Forty
questions.explanation: Matthew 14:20 (ESV): "And they all ate and were satisfied. And they took up twelve baskets full of the broken pieces left over."

questions.question: About how many men ate the food, besides women and children?
options: About five thousand men
About four thousand men
About three thousand men
About seven thousand men
questions.explanation: Matthew 14:21 (ESV): "And those who ate were about five thousand men, besides women and children."

questions.question: Later that night, the disciples' boat was beaten by the waves, and in the fourth watch of the night Jesus came to them doing what?
options: Walking on the sea
Flying through the air
Riding a cloud
Swimming easily against the current
questions.explanation: Matthew 14:25 (ESV): "And in the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea."

questions.question: What did the disciples think they saw when Jesus walked toward them on the water, causing them to cry out in fear?
options: They thought it was a ghost
They thought it was a sea monster
They thought it was an angel of death
They thought it was a mirage
questions.correctAnswer: They thought it was a ghost
questions.explanation: Matthew 14:26 (ESV): "But when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were terrified, and said, 'It is a ghost!' and they cried out in fear."

questions.question: Which disciple told Jesus to command him to come out onto the water?
options: Peter
John
Andrew
Thomas
questions.explanation: Matthew 14:28 (ESV): "And Peter answered him, 'Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the water.'"

questions.question: Why did Peter begin to sink after he had started walking on the water?
options: He saw the wind and became afraid
Jesus removed His power to test him
His shoes became waterlogged
A large wave struck him from behind
questions.correctAnswer: He saw the wind and became afraid
questions.explanation: Matthew 14:30 (ESV): "But when he saw the wind, he was afraid, and beginning to sink he cried out, 'Lord, save me.'"

questions.question: When Jesus took hold of Peter and they got into the boat, the wind ceased. What did those in the boat do and say?
options: They worshiped him, saying, "Truly you are the Son of God."
They were mostly silent in fear
They vowed to never doubt again
They rowed faster to reach the shore
questions.correctAnswer: They worshiped him, saying, "Truly you are the Son of God."
questions.explanation: Matthew 14:33 (ESV): "And those in the boat worshiped him, saying, 'Truly you are the Son of God.'"

key_verse_text: And those in the boat worshiped him, saying, "Truly you are the Son of God."
